```python
from pathlib import Path


def read_names(path):
    names = {}
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        for line in f:
            name = line.strip()
            if name:
                names.setdefault(name.casefold(), name)
    return names


def fmt(names):
    return ", ".join(sorted(names, key=str.casefold)) or "—"


def main():
    folder = Path("дані")
    yesterday = read_names(folder / "вчора.txt")
    today = read_names(folder / "сьогодні.txt")

    added = [today[k] for k in today if k not in yesterday]
    removed = [yesterday[k] for k in yesterday if k not in today]
    kept = sum(1 for k in today if k in yesterday)

    print(f"додано: {fmt(added)}")
    print(f"зникло: {fmt(removed)}")
    print(f"лишилось: {kept}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
